title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves adjusting the values of a variable so that its mean becomes zero. This is done by subtracting the mean of the variable from each data point. How might this affect the intercept term in a regression model?

title: Intercept in Mean-Centered Data
text: When you mean-center your data, the intercept term often represents the mean of the response variable. Consider what happens to the intercept when the mean of the response variable is zero.

title: Effect of Mean-Centering on Intercept
text: If the mean of the response variable is zero, what does this imply about the intercept term in the regression model?
